fields.name: directory
fields.doc: Root directory beneath which the model directory is created.

fields.name: model_name
fields.doc: Stable filename component and master checkpoint stem.

fields.name: context
fields.doc: Optional incremental-checkpoint directory/filename component.

fields.name: max_keep
fields.doc: Maximum retained incremental checkpoints; zero disables rotation.

fields.name: save_best
fields.doc: Whether an improved metric updates the master checkpoint.

fields.name: metric_name
fields.doc: Metric name written into progress metadata and filenames.

fields.name: lower_is_better
fields.doc: Whether a lower metric is considered better.

fields.name: horizon
fields.doc: Number of vector-environment steps in each collection.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Base seed for initial reset and categorical samples.

fields.name: gae
fields.doc: Generalized-advantage estimator policy.

fields.name: environments
fields.doc: Independent device lanes (round-robin over supplied contiguous segments).

fields.name: window
fields.doc: Positive closed-bar window length.

fields.name: horizon
fields.doc: Episode length in bars, 1..=1,000,000; fill counts remain exact in F32.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Full 64-bit deterministic reset seed.

fields.name: capital
fields.doc: Initial analytical capital per independent lane.

fields.name: exposure
fields.doc: Fraction of equity budgeted for entry margin and costs, in (0,1]. Instrument execution rules may additionally admit explicit leverage.

fields.name: taker_fee
fields.doc: Actual-notional taker fee fraction on every execution leg.

fields.name: slippage_bps
fields.doc: Adverse one-way slippage in basis points, excluding spread.

fields.name: spread_bps
fields.doc: Full bid/ask spread in basis points; half is charged per execution leg.

fields.name: max_drawdown
fields.doc: Peak-equity drawdown fraction that terminates and closes inventory.

fields.name: perpetual
fields.doc: Perpetuals use short/flat/long; Spot uses flat/long (no short category).

fields.name: liquidate_at_horizon
fields.doc: Close and terminate at the horizon; otherwise truncate with final-state bootstrap.

fields.name: output
fields.doc: Normalized and affine-transformed NCHW values.

fields.name: mean
fields.doc: Population mean for each channel.

fields.name: variance
fields.doc: Population variance for each channel.

fields.name: output
fields.doc: Maximum value selected from each pooling window.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: Flat input index selected for each output element.

types.name: VqAssignResult
types.doc: Nearest-code indices and gathered code vectors.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: I32 nearest-code index for every latent row.

fields.name: quantized
fields.doc: Gathered winning code for every latent row.

fields.name: inner_size
fields.doc: Width of the z and x projection slices.

fields.name: state_size
fields.doc: Width of each B/C state row.

fields.name: num_heads
fields.doc: Number of selective-state heads.

fields.name: num_rope_angles
fields.doc: Number of rotary angle pairs.

fields.name: num_groups
fields.doc: Number of shared B/C groups.

fields.name: mimo_rank
fields.doc: Number of B/C rows per group.

fields.name: epsilon
fields.doc: Epsilon used by B/C RMS normalization.

fields.name: dt_min
fields.doc: Inclusive lower bound for transformed dt.

fields.name: dt_max
fields.doc: Inclusive upper bound for transformed dt.

fields.name: a_floor
fields.doc: Positive floor for the magnitude of the negative A token.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: Value projection slice.

fields.name: z
fields.doc: Gate projection slice.

fields.name: bh
fields.doc: RMS-normalized B rows.

fields.name: ch
fields.doc: RMS-normalized C rows.

fields.name: dt
fields.doc: Clamped positive time steps.

fields.name: adt
fields.doc: Negative A-times-dt log decays.

fields.name: trap
fields.doc: Raw trapezoidal gates.

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Raw rotary angular velocities.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.doc: Batch size.

fields.name: sequence_length
fields.doc: Sequence length.

fields.name: num_heads
fields.doc: Number of value heads.

fields.name: num_groups
fields.doc: Number of shared Q/K groups, or zero for num_heads.

fields.name: head_dim
fields.doc: Value width per head.

fields.name: state_size
fields.doc: Selective recurrent state width.

fields.name: num_rope_angles
fields.doc: Number of rotary pairs in the state axis.

fields.name: mimo_rank
fields.doc: MIMO rank; SISO callers use one.

fields.name: has_z
fields.doc: Apply the SiLU z gate.

fields.name: has_d
fields.doc: Apply the learned D skip.

fields.name: has_output_norm
fields.doc: Apply MIMO output normalization; SISO requires false.

types.name: PolicyResult
types.doc: One categorical action and its differentiable policy statistics.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: I32 action index for every environment.

fields.name: log_probability
fields.doc: Log probability of each selected action.

fields.name: entropy
fields.doc: Categorical entropy for every environment.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Critic value passed through without a storage copy.

types.name: ContinuousPolicyResult
types.doc: One bounded continuous action and its differentiable policy statistics.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: Action after tanh squashing and affine mapping to the requested range.

fields.name: raw_action
fields.doc: Unsquashed normal sample, retained for exact policy reevaluation.

fields.name: log_probability
fields.doc: Summed corrected log probability for every environment.

fields.name: entropy
fields.doc: Summed base-normal entropy for every environment.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Critic value passed through without a storage copy.

fields.name: loss
fields.doc: Sample-weighted mean validation loss, or NaN when no value is available.

fields.name: batches
fields.doc: Number of validation batches consumed.

fields.name: samples
fields.doc: Number of validation samples consumed.

fields.name: updates
fields.doc: Number of optimizer updates to complete.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.doc: Replay transitions consumed by one update.

fields.name: target_update_interval
fields.doc: Completed-update interval between exact online-to-target copies.

fields.name: observation_shape
fields.doc: Per-transition observation shape expected from replay.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Base seed used by deterministic replay sampling.

fields.name: loss
fields.doc: Bellman-target configuration.

fields.name: updates
fields.doc: Number of critic/actor update pairs to complete.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.doc: Replay transitions consumed by each pair.

fields.name: action_dimensions
fields.doc: Number of scalar continuous action dimensions.

fields.name: target_update_interval
fields.doc: Completed-pair interval between exact critic-to-target copies.

fields.name: observation_shape
fields.doc: Per-transition observation shape expected from replay.

fields.name: action_minimum
fields.doc: Inclusive lower action mapping bound.

fields.name: action_maximum
fields.doc: Inclusive upper action mapping bound.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Base deterministic replay and policy seed.

fields.name: loss
fields.doc: Critic discount and fixed entropy coefficient.

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: Processed command sequence.

fields.name: revision
fields.doc: Revision after processing.

fields.name: disposition
fields.doc: Whether the command was applied.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Live state after processing.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: Rejection evidence, or `None` for an applied command.

fields.name: command_capacity
fields.doc: Maximum queued commands before non-blocking enqueue rejects work.

fields.name: result_capacity
fields.doc: Maximum retained command results.

fields.name: snapshot_capacity
fields.doc: Maximum retained lifecycle snapshots.

fields.name: initial_step
fields.doc: Completed optimizer steps restored before this lifecycle starts.  `total_steps` remains the absolute final budget, not an additional-step count. Restored steps select the next epoch/cursor/scheduler position but are excluded from this process's loss and timing aggregates.

fields.name: total_steps
fields.doc: Completed-step budget; zero keeps the loop open-ended.

fields.name: steps_per_epoch
fields.doc: Fixed steps per epoch; zero disables epoch boundaries.

fields.name: epoch_steps
fields.doc: Variable epoch lengths. When nonempty, these replace `steps_per_epoch` and their sum becomes `total_steps`.

fields.name: batch_size
fields.doc: Samples completed by one step. Zero is normalized to one.

fields.name: sequence_length
fields.doc: Optional sequence work per sample for throughput accounting.

fields.name: sequence_unit
fields.doc: Human-readable sequence unit used by progress and summary callbacks.

fields.name: source_units_per_sample
fields.doc: Optional fixed source units consumed by one sample.

fields.name: source_unit
fields.doc: Human-readable source unit used by progress and summary callbacks.

fields.name: timer_name
fields.doc: Stable name for the device timer represented in reports.

fields.name: enable_gpu_timing
fields.doc: Collect exact device timestamps around submitted training work.

fields.name: rollouts
fields.doc: Number of complete rollout/update cycles.

fields.name: horizon
fields.doc: Time steps collected in each rollout.

fields.name: environments
fields.doc: Vector environments represented by each step.

fields.name: update_epochs
fields.doc: Full-batch optimizer passes over each finalized rollout.

fields.name: update_minibatch_size
fields.doc: Maximum sequences evaluated by one update tape; zero means full batch. Minibatches accumulate sample-weighted gradients with unchanged parameters and one optimizer step per epoch. Advantages normalize over the rollout. Each minibatch completes before the next to bound live device memory.

fields.name: observation_shape
fields.doc: Per-environment observation shape, excluding the environment axis.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Base deterministic categorical sampling seed.

fields.name: enable_gpu_timing
fields.doc: Whether optimizer updates collect Vulkan timestamp statistics. Time all update submissions, summing disjoint minibatch and optimizer intervals into one sample per epoch. Collection remains caller-owned.

fields.name: gae
fields.doc: Generalized-advantage estimator policy.

fields.name: loss
fields.doc: Clipped PPO objective coefficients.

fields.name: rollouts
fields.doc: Number of complete collection cycles.

fields.name: horizon
fields.doc: Time steps stored by each rollout.

fields.name: environments
fields.doc: Vector environments represented by each time step.

fields.name: update_epochs
fields.doc: Full-batch optimizer passes after each collection.

fields.name: timer_name
fields.doc: Device timer label for update steps.

fields.name: enable_gpu_timing
fields.doc: Whether each optimizer update records and resolves Vulkan timestamps.

fields.name: capacity
fields.doc: Maximum number of retained transitions.

fields.name: observation_shape
fields.doc: Per-transition observation shape, excluding the batch axis.

fields.name: action_shape
fields.doc: Per-transition action shape; empty denotes one scalar action.

fields.name: action_dtype
fields.doc: Action storage representation; currently F32 or I32.

fields.name: enable_commands
fields.doc: Enable safe-point pause/resume/checkpoint/evaluate/parameter/recapture commands.

fields.name: enable_pause_resume
fields.doc: Enable `training_pause` and `training_resume`.

fields.name: enable_checkpoint
fields.doc: Enable `training_checkpoint`.

fields.name: enable_evaluate
fields.doc: Enable `training_evaluate`.

fields.name: enable_set_parameter
fields.doc: Enable `training_set_parameter`.

fields.name: enable_recapture
fields.doc: Enable `training_request_recapture`.

fields.name: enable_stop
fields.doc: Enable `training_stop` (separately gated because it changes the terminal path).

fields.name: horizon
fields.doc: Number of vector-environment steps to evaluate.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Reset seed and deterministic greedy operation seed.

fields.name: discount
fields.doc: Next-state value discount in the inclusive range `[0, 1]`.

types.name: DqnLossResult
types.doc: Selected action values, detached targets, and scalar DQN loss.

fields.name: selected_q
fields.doc: Q values selected by the batch's action indices, shaped `[batch]`.

fields.name: target_q
fields.doc: Detached Bellman targets, shaped `[batch]`.

fields.name: loss
fields.doc: Mean unit-beta Smooth L1 loss between selected and target Q values.

fields.name: clip_epsilon
fields.doc: Symmetric policy-ratio clipping distance.

fields.name: value_coefficient
fields.doc: Multiplier for critic mean-squared error.

fields.name: entropy_coefficient
fields.doc: Multiplier subtracted for policy entropy.

types.name: PpoLossResult
types.doc: PPO loss components retained for metrics and reverse mode.

fields.name: policy_loss
fields.doc: Mean negative clipped surrogate objective.

fields.name: value_loss
fields.doc: Mean-squared critic error.

fields.name: entropy
fields.doc: Mean policy entropy.

fields.name: total_loss
fields.doc: `policy_loss + value_coefficient * value_loss - entropy_coefficient * entropy`.

fields.name: discount
fields.doc: Next-state value discount in the inclusive range `[0, 1]`.

fields.name: entropy_coefficient
fields.doc: Non-negative entropy temperature.

types.name: SacCriticLossResult
types.doc: Detached target and twin-critic SAC loss components.

fields.name: target_q
fields.doc: Detached entropy-regularized Bellman target, shaped `[batch]`.

fields.name: q1_loss
fields.doc: Mean-squared loss for the first critic.

fields.name: q2_loss
fields.doc: Mean-squared loss for the second critic.

fields.name: total_loss
fields.doc: Sum of both critic losses.

fields.name: observation_size
fields.doc: Number of scalar features in each observation.

fields.name: action_count
fields.doc: Number of discrete actions; must be at least two.

fields.name: hidden_size
fields.doc: Width of both hidden layers in each independent tower.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Seed for the first of six independent Xavier-uniform projections.

fields.name: gamma
fields.doc: Reward discount applied to value bootstrap and the reverse trace.

fields.name: lambda
fields.doc: Trace discount applied to the next advantage.

types.name: GaeResult
types.doc: Generalized advantages and their matching value targets.

fields.name: advantage
fields.doc: Advantage estimates with the same `[time, environments]` shape as reward.

fields.name: returns
fields.doc: Returns computed as `advantage + value`.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Number of time steps retained per collection cycle.

fields.name: environments
fields.doc: Number of vector environments represented by every step.

fields.name: observation_shape
fields.doc: Per-environment observation shape, excluding the environment axis.
